name: C&E Matrix
whenToUse: When several process inputs are to be ranked by how strongly they act on the outputs that matter to the customer — the weighted row sum says which input to investigate first; not for rating failure modes by occurrence and detection, which is what the FMEA is for.
legendInfo: Σ = weighted sum of row / column
scoreRejected: “{value}” is not on the scale — allowed: {allowed}.
offScale: {count} rating(s) are not on the new scale and are marked.
lastInput: The last input cannot be removed.
lastOutput: The last output cannot be removed.

invariants.inputIds: Every input has its own non-empty id without a colon.
invariants.outputIds: Every output has its own non-empty id without a colon.
invariants.knownCells: A rating belongs to an existing input and an existing output.
